verdict.rationale: The DGX B200 is a physical system that customers run in their own data centers. The docs describe node-level and data-center health monitoring, on-box management via BMC, Redfish, IPMI, SNMP, KVM and a web UI, a local Docker and NVIDIA Container Toolkit stack, and support for physically moving the system. Community hands-on reports confirm operators running and virtualizing HGX B200 on their own infrastructure. Missing for 10: an explicit on-premises installation or deployment guide in the evidence, and a fully open self-hostable stack (the required Fabric Manager is closed source).
